"""Actually inspect every authored web page and its estimated-time banner."""

import functools
import hashlib
import json
import threading
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

ROOT = Path.cwd()
SITE = ROOT / "outputs/integration-preview"
OUT = ROOT / "outputs/integration-runs/browser-final"


class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/tiny-perceptron-vlm/"):
            self.path = self.path.removeprefix("/tiny-perceptron-vlm")
        super().do_GET()

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    inventory = json.loads((ROOT / "outputs/reading-time/inventory.json").read_text())
    estimates = {row["page_id"]: row for row in json.loads((ROOT / "course/reading-times.json").read_text())["pages"]}
    assert len(inventory["pages"]) == len(estimates) == 282
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), functools.partial(Handler, directory=str(SITE)))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    records, errors = [], []
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as playwright:
            browser = playwright.chromium.launch(executable_path="/usr/bin/chromium", args=["--no-sandbox"])
            page = browser.new_page()
            page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
            for width, height in ((1440, 1100), (390, 844)):
                page.set_viewport_size({"width": width, "height": height})
                for position, item in enumerate(inventory["pages"]):
                    identifier = item["page_id"]
                    response = page.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/{identifier}.html", wait_until="load")
                    assert response.status == 200
                    page.evaluate("document.fonts.ready")
                    page.wait_for_function(
                        "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img.diagram')).every(x => x.complete && x.naturalWidth > 0)"
                    )
                    banner = page.locator(".reading-time")
                    assert banner.count() == 1, (identifier, banner.count())
                    estimate = estimates[identifier]
                    expected = f"閱讀約 {estimate['minutes_min']}–{estimate['minutes_max']} 分鐘 · AI 估計"
                    assert banner.inner_text().strip() == expected
                    actual_width = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
                    assert actual_width <= width, (identifier, width, actual_width)
                    figures = page.locator("img.diagram").evaluate_all(
                        "items => items.map(x => ({src: x.getAttribute('src'), width: x.getBoundingClientRect().width, naturalWidth: x.naturalWidth}))"
                    )
                    if width == 1440:
                        assert all(row["width"] > 600 for row in figures), (identifier, figures)
                    records.append(
                        {
                            "page": identifier,
                            "viewport": width,
                            "document_width": actual_width,
                            "banner": expected,
                            "diagrams": figures,
                            "cpu_outputs": page.locator(".output").count(),
                        }
                    )
                    if identifier in {"index", "1.1", "13.12", "19.2"}:
                        if identifier in {"13.12", "19.2"}:
                            page.locator("img.diagram").first.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{identifier}-{width}.png"))
                    if (position + 1) % 50 == 0:
                        print(json.dumps({"viewport": width, "pages_checked": position + 1}), flush=True)
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join()
    assert not errors, errors
    result = {
        "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "scope": "Actual Chromium reading-time banner, diagram load, content width and JavaScript error checks on all 282 authored pages at desktop and mobile viewport sizes. System 404 is excluded. This is not physical-device testing, human reading-time measurement or Colab execution.",
        "records": records,
        "page_errors": errors,
        "build_info": json.loads((SITE / "build-info.json").read_text()),
        "tested_authored_inventory_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (ROOT / "outputs/reading-time/inventory.json").read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "tested_reading_time_metadata_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (ROOT / "course/reading-times.json").read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "tested_current_notebook_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-current-notebooks.json").read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "build_revision_note": "The local preview can include uncommitted authored changes relative to build_info.revision. Its actual inputs are bound above. Final GitHub Pages is separately built by CI at the pushed revision and verified after deployment.",
        "screenshots": {path.name: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(OUT.glob("*.png"))},
        "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    }
    (OUT / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"page_checks": len(records), "all_banners_match": True, "page_errors": errors}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
